entry.name: ezdac~
entry.description: ezdac~ works as a user interface version of the dac~ object. It appears as a button which can be clicked with the mouse to turn audio on or off.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: Clicking ontoggles audio processing on or off. Audio on is represented by the object being highlighted.

messages.name: int
messages.description: A non-zero number turns on audio processing in all loaded patches.turns off audio processing in all loaded patches.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Set the logical output channels for each signal inlet
messages.description: comprised of integers, sets the logical output channels for each signal inlet in order from left to right.

messages.name: local
messages.digest: Enable audio processing in local patch and subpatches only
messages.description: The word, followed by, makes a click to turn on anobject equivalent to sending it the. The messagereturns theobject to its default mode where a click to turn it on is equivalent to themessage.

messages.name: open
messages.description: Opens the Audio Status window. The window is also brought to the front.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set the output channel for signal inlet where themessage was received
messages.description: In any inlet: The word, followed by a number, sets the logical output channel for the signal inlet in which themessage was received. For instance, sendingto the left inlet ofmakes the signal coming in the left inlet output to logical output channel 3.Note that if the audio is on and you use themessage to change ato use logical channels that are not currently in use, no sound will be heard from these channels until the audio is turned off and on again.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: In left inlet: The signal is sent to audio output channel 1. The signal in each inlet must be between -1 and 1 to avoid clipping by the DAC.In right inlet: The signal is sent to audio output channel 2.

messages.name: start
messages.digest: Turn on audio processing in all loaded patches.
messages.description: Turns on audio processing in all loaded patches.

messages.name: startwindow
messages.digest: Enable audio processing in local patch and subpatches only
messages.description: Turns on audio processing only in the patch in which thisis located, and in subpatches of that patch. Turns off audio processing in all other patches.

messages.name: stop
messages.digest: Turns off audio processing in all loaded patches.
messages.description: Turns off audio processing in all loaded patches.
